items.title: Chatham Financial Scales Workflows with OpenAI
items.summary: Chatham Financial is utilizing OpenAI's Codex and GPT-5.6 to develop technology and redesign its workflows. By applying these models, the firm has cut trade validation times down from 30 minutes to under 4 minutes.
keyPoints: Chatham Financial uses Codex and GPT-5.6.
The tools are deployed to build technology and redesign workflows.
Trade validation time was reduced from 30 minutes to under 4 minutes.
